title: Concept: Pub dependency pinned to a moving git reference
description: pubspec.yaml declares a git dependency whose ref is a branch name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a git dependency whose ref is a branch name.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a git dependency whose ref is a branch name.
